title: Chilaquiles
description: Chilaquiles is a dish from Mexico prepared with corn tortillas, red salsa, chicken egg, queso fresco. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 8 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 10 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Combine the prepared components from earlier steps gently into the intended final mixture; do not add new ingredients.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 5 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
